chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Ali ibn Muhammad, both together, from Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Taymi, from Ayoub ibn Nuh, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Jundab, who said:
I heard Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying: There is no problem with eating the meat of buffaloes, drinking their milk, and eating their butter.
ai.seo_question: Is buffalo meat and milk halal in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) explicitly confirms the permissibility of consuming buffalo (*al-jawamis*) meat, milk, and butter, resolving specific juristic queries about these animals. It highlights the Shia principle of general permissibility (*al-asl fi al-akl al-halal*) for land animals unless explicitly prohibited, reinforcing the purity (*taharah*) of these dairy products. This ruling is particularly significant in regions where buffalo are prevalent, providing clear guidance on their culinary status within Islamic law.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Ali Bin Muhammad, both together from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Tameemy, from Ayoub Bin Nuh, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Jundab who said,
‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘There is no problem with eating the Buffalo meats and drinking their milks, and eating their butter’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from and Afi ibn Muhammad all from Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Tamimiy from Ayyub ibn Nuh from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Abd Allah ibn Jundab who has said the following: “
I once heard abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘It is not unlawful to eat buffalo meat and the use of its milk and ghee for food.’”
